integrity: Proof provides the analytic continuum and data-simplex extrema, strict branch monotonicity, and a unique minimax crossing. An exact-arithmetic bracket is reproduced by verify.py; finite random samples supplement but do not prove the theorem. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only four symmetric distinct nodes with fixed endpoints and nondecreasing data in [0,1]; the cubic need not itself be monotone; asymmetric grids, higher degrees, and unindexed equivalent old calculations are not resolved.
title: Optimal symmetric four-node cubic interpolation for monotone range control
